description: Ensemble of CART decision trees with bootstrap aggregation (bagging) and random feature subsets.

math.prediction: y_hat = (1/B) * sum_{b=1}^{B} T_b(x)  where T_b is tree b
math.split_criterion: MSE reduction: gain = var(y_parent) - [n_L/n * var(y_L) + n_R/n * var(y_R)]
math.bias_variance: Averaging B trees reduces variance by ~1/B if trees are uncorrelated. Random feature subset (sqrt(p)) decorrelates trees.
math.intuition: Each tree is trained on a bootstrap sample and uses only sqrt(p) random features at each split. Ensemble averages out individual tree noise while preserving non-linear patterns.

assumptions: Sufficient trees to reduce variance below single-tree variance
Features are on comparable scales (trees are scale-invariant, but scaling kept for consistency)
Rolling features capture sufficient temporal context for single-sample prediction

training.nan_strategy: drop rows with any NaN in features
